ops.body: - The numbers are the second prototype's "Proposed" settings (https://claude.ai/artifact/7oLxtuZMhpvXd18H4BLR5P) until the owner sends tuned ones; only `REPLAY_RHYTHM` changes

- [owner] The owner's leanings for the rework's later slices (Nov 18; `specs/replay-pace/spec.md`, Decisions), none built and each to go through `/vision` before its own spec: a break as a pull-back and a slide across a dotted hop with no dim; a wider walking zoom with a camera that holds then re-frames (it first needs the owner's call on how the map is driven, `docs/research/replay-ceremony-direction-audit.md`, the auditor's F1); the replay flowing in from the whole walk and closing on it; a photo staying on its pin and in a stack at the edge, one entry a moment, the oldest dropping off (amends RR11); a moment's videos and memos one after another, not in the grid (amends MS17); captions in the replay under memos and videos (extends 0169)

- Left out on purpose: the map dimming under a photo and a held photo's slow drift (two reviewers disagreed; the owner's to see in the prototype); going back a moment (a press of Next mid-memo cuts it, as Skip does); taking a replay up again after a reload; a ceiling on length (the owner chose Next instead); sound that leads or trails its picture (it needs a player made before its slot)

- [owner] The cold finds (Nov 18, two passes, pictures only) could not tell what Skip skips: "skip this stretch" was the first reading, and a wrong tap ends the replay with no way back; "Hold" was found only by elimination ("press and hold", or "keep this"). Next now says its word beside it, which is what the owner's "a chevron, tested" asked for; whether Skip should say where it goes ("To the end") and Hold say Pause is a wording call across both replays

- [loop] From the UI review (Nov 18, low): Next sits 8 px under Skip (Material's 8 dp; the HIG asks about 12 for bezelled buttons), and its foot (y 116) is 2 px above a card's highest top (`STACK_TOP` 118) on a 320 to 375 px phone, so more gap means raising `STACK_TOP`; no journey pictures the long line under the clock ("Passed … without stopping", RY21) at 320 px, held or not: the room is arithmetic (`STAGE_SIDE`, `replay-pace ui 2`, `ui 3`), and a 360 x 640 picture was asked for too

- A press that jumps several passed places says each for its 2.6 s, one after another, under the clock, so three places are almost 8 s of lines; nothing shortens that (RY21). On one walk more than two are already one line (RP19); a day of several walks can still say several

- [owner] The `gaps` journey fails on `main` at "gap-drawing audit 4: Done waits for the paths" (3 of 3 runs of `npm run e2e:baseline -- gaps` on `4827a15`, Nov 18; the same on the replay-pace branch): with the fake tiles slowed by 4 s, Draw my way's bar opens already saying "Tap along the way you walked", never "Reading the paths", and Done is not disabled. Not a flake, so not in `scripts/e2e/flaky.json`. Unconfirmed guess at the cause: `main` now keeps the last tile bodies in memory (`createTileBodies`, `discovery/tileBodies.ts`), so the paths of tiles read moments before are at hand and the journey's slow-tiles step no longer makes them wait; then the check is stale rather than the app wrong, but nothing was run to show it. Replay pace was deployed over it on the owner's call (it does not touch gap drawing); the journey ran 19 checks before stopping there, so the checks after it were not run on that build

argv: The 60 s cap shrinks a grid below its video
the cap and fitCap are gone (replay pace RY10, decision 0203): a grid keeps its video's length (pace.test.ts RY4)

ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** replay a walk with three or more moments; press Next during a stretch, then again while a voice memo plays, then with the replay held. **Expect:** each press shows the next moment within a second; the memo's sound stops at once; held, it stays held (Hold reads Play) and Play goes on from there; after the last moment Next is gone and Skip remains. (RY13, RY14, RY15, RY16, RY17)
- [ ] **Do:** with VoiceOver or TalkBack on, open a walk's replay and a day's. **Expect:** the steps with Continue, one moment at a time, as before; no Next button anywhere. (RY20)

- [ ] **Do:** replay a walk with a photo on its own, a 10 s voice memo and a video, with no touch. **Expect:** the photo stays fully shown about 4.5 s (the first one about 5.4 s); the walker stands about a second after the memo's last word; the video's card stands about a second after it ends; the screen stays awake through the whole replay, minutes long (expo-keep-awake). (RY1, RY2, RY6)

- [ ] **Do:** on an iPhone SE or mini (375 pt wide), replay a walk past a place it passed and across a break, pressing Next over both. **Expect:** "N min later", then "Passed … without stopping", show under the clock between Hold and the Skip and Next column, wrapped, over no button and no card. (RY21)

| Replay pace (the first slice of the replay's rework: a photo on its own fully shown 4.5 s, the first and one after 550 m a fifth longer, photos at one stop tightening with the last whole again; a moment's grid held 5 s; a note's wait by the word and its bubble never taken before it could be read; a second of quiet after a memo or video; a steady walker; no 60 s cap; a Next button under Skip, on both replays, that goes to the next moment, counts nothing and never edits out the lows; decision 0203) | built 2026-11-18 on `claude/funny-bohr-ztvwgv`, test-first in the history's order (see the spec's record on `check:test-first`), steward on the plan, a cold find twice and a UI review on the pictures; native not run on a device | the slice's commits on `claude/funny-bohr-ztvwgv`, 2026-11-18 | `specs/replay-pace/spec.md` (RY1-RY22) | no (the direction was audited before the spec: `docs/research/replay-ceremony-direction-audit.md`) |
